scientific_integrity: Exact inequality and support-size theorem for expected distinct-species counts under independent replacement sampling, with an analytic all-parameter proof for support sizes at most three and rational four-species witness verified by independent exact arithmetic. This result has undergone same-model scientific review, not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The conclusion concerns existential two-reversal sample-size rankings, not all possible crossing counts for four or more species; it does not concern field estimates, finite-population without-replacement sampling, or inference from random sample realizations. Related literature already describes intersections, so historical priority for the precise sharp support-size statement remains a risk.
title: Four species are necessary and sufficient for two reversals in expected species accumulation rankings
